column1: Mainly fair weather will prevail over the sea areas around the island.

Winds will be south-westerly. Wind speed will be (30-40) kmph. Wind speed can increase up to 50
kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Puttalam to Kankasanthurai via Mannar
and from, Hambantota to Pottuvil.

The sea areas off the coasts extending from Puttalam to Kankasanthurai via Mannar and from
Hambantota to Pottuvil will be fairly rough at times.
The wave height may increase about (2.0 – 2.5) meters in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Puttalam to Pottuvil via Colombo, Galle and Hambantota.
